cand.name: Drill Pipe Body (Seamless Tube)
cand.brief_description: Long thin-walled seamless cylinder forming the bulk of the drill pipe — parametrized by OD (D), wall thickness (t), inner diameter (d) and length; carries axial/torsional load between tool joints.
